# graviteeam_org_user_token (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM organization user account access token

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_org_user" "example" {
  username         = "org-token-user"
  password         = "SecurePass123!"
  email            = "org-token-user@example.com"
  first_name       = "Org"
  last_name        = "Token"
  enabled          = true
  pre_registration = true
}

resource "graviteeam_org_user_token" "example" {
  user_id = graviteeam_org_user.example.id
  name    = "automation-token"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The token name
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the organization user

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Terraform ID of the organization user token
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The generated token value. Gravitee AM returns this only at creation time.
- `token_id` (String) The ID of the generated token
